name: @aip/api-client
description: Typed API client generated from apps/api OpenAPI (openapi-typescript + orval TanStack Query). Never hand-edited: run `pnpm --filter api-client generate`.

scripts.generate: node ./scripts/generated.mjs clean && openapi-typescript ./openapi.json --output ./src/generated/schema.ts && orval --config ./orval.config.ts && node ./scripts/generated.mjs header
